description: Add eligible voters (email, optional name and unit) to a DRAFT election in the connected account. Idempotent: people already on the list are skipped. Returns how many were added and the updated price. For a published election, voters are added by the organizer on the election page, because a larger list can change the price.

voters.description: The eligible voters (the roster), one per owner/member. Email addresses only; people reached by text or mail are added by the organizer on the election page.

name.description: Owner or member name, shown on the roster.

unit.description: Unit, lot or address label, e.g. "Unit 4B".

name: add_voters
title: Add voters to a draft election
